description: 3D creation suite. Its UI is drawn with OpenGL, so elements come from OCR and the screenshot.
tips: Keyboard shortcuts act on the area under the mouse: move the mouse over the 3D viewport (center of the window) first.
Add a cube: mouse over the viewport, hotkey shift+a, then click Mesh, then Cube.
The default startup scene already contains a cube; a splash screen may need a click outside it or Escape.
Delete the selected object: x then click Delete (needs approval).
